changes.before: Polish equities should be approached through domestic execution and regional financing risk. Money.pl describes markets greeting the European political reset unfavorably, while Bankier's report of unusually strong consumer purchasing says inflation has left a lasting mark. The practical implication is not that demand has vanished, but that the composition and profitability of spending matter. A retailer may benefit from volumes while customers remain price-sensitive; a lender may earn fees while facing a more uncertain market risk premium. Keep the distinction between a growing economy and a market willing to pay more for its earnings. The European political shock makes that distinction more important for internationally held regional assets. [[n2074]] [[n1979]]
